title: Powerset codes and actual module subsheaves on a small ringed site
statement: Fix a universe $\mathcal V$ [def-weil-size-convention], a $\mathcal V$-small site $\mathcal C$ [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology] with object set $K$, a sheaf of rings $R$ with $\mathcal V$-small section sets, and an $R$-module sheaf $P$ with $\mathcal V$-small section sets [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. Define $D(P)=\prod_{V\in K}\mathcal P(P(V))$. A family $s\in D(P)$ is a module-subsheaf code if there exists a restriction-stable family of $R(V)$-submodules $N(V)\subseteq P(V)$ with underlying subsets $s(V)$ whose inherited module presheaf is a sheaf. Let $E(P)$ be the subset of $D(P)$ of these codes. For $s\in E(P)$, recover this family of submodules (determined by its underlying subsets), equip its subsets with the inherited module operations and restriction maps to obtain the actual sheaf $N_s$, and let $\iota_s:N_s\to P$ be the subset inclusion.
